title: Skipped heading level
user_impact: Screen reader users navigating by headings assume that sections are missing.
technical_impact: Heading levels do not follow each other without gaps.

checks.source: Best practice, no WCAG failure: G141 and H42 (advisory) for SC 1.3.1/2.4.10; axe heading-order
checks.applicability: Rendered headings in document order, from the second heading on.
checks.expectation:
Flags a heading whose level is more than one deeper than the previous rendered
heading (h2 followed by h4), at that heading. Going back up any number of
levels (h3 to h1) or one level down is fine; the first heading may have any
level. Hidden headings (display:none) are not part of the outline, so a hidden
h5 between two h3 is no skip. Skipping levels is not a WCAG failure (G141 is
advisory), so the finding is a best-practice violation without a success
criterion.
